verdict.rationale: Weave's own marketing pages describe custom signals that automatically classify agent interactions, and alerts that send Slack notifications and trigger webhook automations. That amounts to event-triggered actions you can define, but the evidence is marketing-level only. It does not document how rules, conditions or action types are configured. missing for 10: first-party docs on defining alert/automation rules (event types, conditions, action configuration), webhook payload/registration details, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Alerts route what matters through Slack notifications and trigger webhook automations, turning every production insight into a fast iteration.
Built-in and custom signals automatically capture and classify agent interactions
